purpose: Collect the v0.0.1 release-prep receipts and provenance in one artifact so the next migration slice can proceed from durable evidence rather than chat memory.

proven: CUJ-derived test coverage is explicit: 69 required Swift test obligations plus 7 release evidence checks across 16 active CUJs.
Vaporize package tests pass through Vaporize toolchain mode: 87 executable Swift tests across 16 implemented CUJ-specific SwiftPM test bundles, including CUJ-16 target feature inspection.
The product definition defines Vaporize, primary users, product-level user journeys, choice argument, non-choice cases, and build implications before further build work is accepted.

The PRD review session gate is codified: Engineering, QA, and Marketing review the PRD before major coding starts; v0.0.1 records a backfilled GO-WITH-NOTES correction because implementation was already in flight.
Legacy XcodeGen project.yml files parse through the Swift YAML read bridge.
All 155 discovered project.yml files under private/universal/substrate/collectives parsed through inspect-project-yml.
Concourse old XcodeGen script build and Vaporize app build both pass after Vaporize derives legacy WRAPPER_NAME from project.yml.
Concourse project.pkl evaluates through PklSwift and matches the Swift-read project.yml parity signature with zero mismatches.
Concourse project.pkl generates transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML through PklSwift, and the generated YAML compares back to Pkl with zero mismatches.
Creative Selection v0.2 project.yml imports into a generated project.pkl parity specimen, evaluates through PklSwift, and compares back to YAML with zero mismatches.
Creative Selection v0.2 project.pkl generates first-slice .xcodeproj world-state through Vaporize generate-xcodeproj.
Shared Xcode workspace product-cache reuse has a first slice: cache-first app lookup, paired option validation, and shared workspace/DerivedData build invocation are covered by CUJ-15.

Hello World Google target feature inspection passes through inspect-target-features, proving project configs, release tiers, configFiles wiring, generated xcconfigs, generated ReleaseFeatures.swift, and digikoma-release-features provenance for the reference target.

The release-facing why-vaporize explainer exists and records current Swift/xcodebuild/xcrun comparison, local benchmark baselines, build-space savings theory, user ergonomics, and unmeasured benchmark gaps.
The performance marketing claims matrix exists and separates approved measured, behavioral, and theoretical claim language from prohibited speed and disk-space claims.
The package-local vaporize.engineering.docc catalog exists as the human engineering narrative for future wrkstrm.com/engineering publication, with release evidence remaining the proof corpus.
The package-local feature catalog exists as the canonical human-readable feature list and explanation surface for Vaporize.

The package-local modularity and ownership boundary exists: genuinely Swift Universal primitives belong in swift-universal, Apple-bounded orchestration belongs in wrkstrm-core, and Vaporize feature bodies should not accumulate in the CLI router.

A Kura runtime sample series is seeded for Vaporize, with a backfilled CUJ-09 coverage sample that verifies SwiftPM code coverage JSON, raw profile data, merged profile data, build-output size, product size, codecov artifact size, and binary size from a Vaporize toolchain run.
Initial schema-universal extraction exists as vaporize-schemas v0.0.1 for CUJ coverage, provenance, launch-review specialization, and Apple project YAML/Pkl receipts.
JSON release evidence validates through Vaporize validate-json.
notProven: The full fleet builds through Vaporize.
Pkl-backed .xcodeproj generation covers scheme/resource/package feature parity across the required fleet.
Vaporize automatically discovers the requested product or scheme from the shared Xcode workspace cache.
Fleet-wide performance or disk-space savings have been measured.
Vaporize automatically emits Kura runtime samples, retains Apple/Swift native artifacts as durable release evidence, or compares per-feature-flag build-size cohorts.
Vaporize performs registry-backed app-minimums inspection across the full wrkstrm app fleet.
Remaining XcodeGen surfaces are migrated or quarantined.
Vaporize v0.0.1 is ready for final internal-essential release.

boundaries: This artifact is provenance for release-prep work, not founder approval.
This artifact does not mark Vaporize v0.0.1 internally releasable.
Legacy project.yml read compatibility is a bridge for comparison and migration, not the forward source-of-truth claim.
Generated project.pkl import specimens are migration evidence, not .xcodeproj generators.
Generated transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML is migration evidence, not a checked-in project.yml replacement or .xcodeproj generator.
Shared Xcode workspace product-cache reuse is a cache lookup and build-invocation slice, not automatic workspace product discovery.
The why-vaporize benchmark baseline is local release-prep evidence and must not be presented as fleet performance proof.

The first runtime sample is backfilled and references ephemeral SwiftPM build artifacts; it proves the target shape, not automatic Vaporize emission, durable artifact retention, or per-feature-flag size comparison.

The wrkstrm-core build-config composition correction identifies existing sources of truth; Vaporize does not yet automatically join registry, identifier, app-artifacts, and release-feature records into app-facing samples.
The wrkstrm app-minimums target-level slice inspects project.yml targets; Vaporize does not yet join registry, identifier, app-artifacts, and release-feature records across the fleet.
Concourse build comparison is one-specimen evidence and must not be generalized to the whole fleet without additional receipts.
